name: Philosophy in the Boudoir (2022)
source:
To corrupt young Eugenie and destroy all her beliefs about virtue and religion through philosophy — is your task as a teacher-libertine.

Eugenie's education is her initiation into enjoyment of her body as a practice of language. Because whole, the work of the bedroom schoolmasters is primarily to enter into language, into knowledge, and into desire: philosophy is taught in the bedroom, and exposition takes place in the midst of an orgy.

[From [url=https://desaze.itch.io/boudoir]itch.io[/url]]

A visual novel based on the novel "La philosophie dans le boudoir" written by Marquis de Sade.
translation:
通过哲学腐蚀年轻的尤金妮并摧毁她所有关于美德和宗教的信仰——这是你作为一个浪荡子教师的任务。

尤金妮接受的教育是她开始享受自己的身体作为语言的实践。因为整体来说，卧室校长的工作主要是进入语言、知识和欲望：哲学是在卧室里教授的，阐述是在狂欢中进行的。

[来自[url=https://desaze.itch.io/boudoir]itch.io[/url]]

根据萨德侯爵的小说《闺房中的哲学》改编的视觉小说。
